cells.quote: Regression estimates indicate that there was a significant difference between the composite math score of students in the treatment condition as compared to the control condition (𝛽 = 0.19, 𝑝 < 0.05), controlling for pre-math composite score, pre-SEL composite score, gender, and individualized education program (IEP) status. The average impacts on the other math subscores were also positive (Figure 2).
